name: Improved Fetch
body:
The companion or familiar can retrieve multiple thrown weapons at once.

Prerequisites: Companion or Familiar level 3rd, Fetch

Benefit(s): Your ability to retrieve thrown weapons has improved greatly. When using the Fetch feat, you may return up to two thrown weapons at once. The number of thrown weapons that you can retrieve increases by 1 at 8th level, and again at 13th level.
